title: I made a game about couriers throwing packages. This is what delivery looks like in my city :D
author: LengthinessIcy460
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on my game **Out of Delivery** for about 10 months now, and I wanted to share what I've been making!

The idea is pretty simple: you're a robot courier working for a delivery company that cares about one thing only, PROFIT. Up to 10 players compete in chaotic delivery matches where the goal is to deliver packages, earn credits and finish with more money than everyone else.

But of course, things don't always go according to plan... You can throw packages, steal deliveries from other players, mess with your opponents, use different gadgets and try to get your deliveries done before time runs out.

I've been developing the game mostly on my own. Some of the models, especially props and smaller environmental assets, were also created with the help of AI tools. It's been a long journey with lots of things to learn, change and improve along the way. I'm still working on it and trying to make the game as fun as possible.

**If chaotic multiplayer games sound like your thing, I'd really appreciate it if you checked out Out of Delivery and added it to your Steam wishlist!**

[**https://store.steampowered.com/app/5326400/Out\_of\_Delivery/**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5326400/Out_of_Delivery/)
